elements.name: 画一个全局架构图
elements.description:
使用Layered Viewpoint,画一个架构图插入README中，重点表达granph-driven agentic engineering中AGENT、ARGO MCP、graph、ARCHIMATE3.2、EA、人类间的关系

Layered Viewpoint 
The layered viewpoint pictures several layers and aspects of an Enterprise Architecture in one 
diagram. There are two categories of layers, namely dedicated layers and service layers. The 
layers are the result of the use of the “grouping” relationship for a natural partitioning of the entire 
set of objects and relationships that belong to a model. The technology, application, process, and 
actor/role layers belong to the first category. The structural principle behind a fully layered 
viewpoint is that each dedicated layer exposes, by means of the “realization” relationship, a layer 
of services, which are further on “serving” the next dedicated layer. Thus, we can easily separate 
the internal structure and organization of a dedicated layer from its externally observable behavior 
expressed as the service layer that the dedicated layer realizes. The order, number, or nature of 
these layers are not fixed, but in general a (more or less) complete and natural layering of an 
ArchiMate model should contain the succession of layers depicted in the example given in Table 
27. However, this example is by no means intended to be prescriptive. The main goal of the layered 
viewpoint is to provide an overview in one diagram. Furthermore, this viewpoint can be used as 
support for impact of change analysis and performance analysis or for extending the service 
portfolio.

elements.name: ARGO 部署脚本
elements.description: 提供一个打包脚本 install-argo.ps1：将 argo/schema、argo/scripts、argo/package.json 部署到 ~/.argo，将 argo/skills/argo-init 部署到 ~/.copilot/skills/argo-init，将 argo/rules/archgraph.instructions.md 部署到 %APPDATA%\Code\User\prompts；部署后在 ~/.argo 运行 npm install 安装 neo4j-driver 依赖（-SkipDeps 跳过）；安装时交互式收集 env 参数并生成 ~/.argo/.env（可留空后补）；自动在 %APPDATA%\Code\User\mcp.json 注册 argo MCP server（合并已有配置，不含 cwd/env；全局 server 通过 MCP roots/list 请求动态发现当前工作区，工作区相关工具调用等待 roots 解析后再执行，多工作区时优先选择含 design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json 的根）；temp 保留在仓库目录不部署。

testcases.name: AT-1361-01-部署脚本可运行
testcases.description: GIVEN install-argo.ps1 已就绪；WHEN 以 -SkipEnv -SkipDeps 与非交互方式运行到临时目录；THEN 生成 schema/SystemArchitecture.schema.json、scripts/argo-mcp-server.js、skills/argo-init/SKILL.md、prompts/archgraph.instructions.md 与 package.json（含 neo4j-driver 依赖），并写入 mcp.json 注册 argo MCP server，且不部署 temp 与 .env。
testcases.acceptanceCriteria: tests/argo-deploy.test.js

testcases.name: AT-1361-02-全局server动态发现工作区
testcases.description: GIVEN argo MCP server 已部署到 ~/.argo 且 mcp.json 不含 cwd/env；WHEN VS Code 启动 server、完成 initialize/initialized 后 server 发送 roots/list 请求，客户端返回当前工作区 roots；THEN 工作区相关的 tools/call 以该工作区为 workspaceRoot 解析 design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json 并通过验证（而非 home 目录）。
testcases.acceptanceCriteria: tests/argo-global-install.test.js
